items.title: Amazon DocumentDB now supports direct major version upgrades to version 8.0
items.blurb: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports in-place major version upgrades (MVU) directly from engine versions 3.6 and 4.0 to version 8.0.

items.title: Amazon Redshift now supports AWS IAM Identity Center authentication with enhanced VPC routing
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift now supports AWS IAM Identity Center authentication for provisioned clusters and serverless workgroups configured with enhanced VPC routing (EVR).

items.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB is now available in 8 additional AWS Regions
items.blurb: You can now use Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB in the Africa (Cape Town), Asia Pacific (Bangkok), Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), Asia Pacific (Melbourne), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Europe (Zurich), and Israel (Tel Aviv)…

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports warm-up periods for alarms
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch now lets you configure a warm-up period for metric alarms and log alarms, delaying alarm evaluation for a set time after the alarm is created.

items.title: AWS Agent Registry agents and MCP servers now available in Amazon Quick
items.blurb: Today, Amazon Quick announces integration with AWS Agent Registry, enabling users to discover and use resources from their organization's AWS Agent Registry directly within Amazon Quick.

items.title: Partner Revenue Measurement expands service coverage for User Agent string capability
items.blurb: Partner Revenue Measurement User Agent string now supports additional AWS services. Partner Revenue Measurement allows Partners to better understand their AWS revenue impact and product consumption patterns.
